source: pkg/modules/pdf/stage_types.go and helpers.go in Gotenberg; defaults from litho. npm run check:api compares the names with a Gotenberg checkout.

stages.summary: Appends the PDFs into one, in the alphanumeric order of their names. The result takes the name of the first.
Cuts each PDF into several, which come back in a ZIP: `report_0.pdf`, `report_1.pdf`… The stages after it run on each part.

options.name: every
options.description: Cuts every this many pages. Set `every` or `ranges`, not both.

options.name: ranges
options.description: One PDF per entry, each a page selection such as `1-3` or `4,6`.

stages.summary: Keeps the pages you list, in the order you list them.

options.name: pages
options.description: The pages to keep, such as `3,1` or `1-2`.

stages.summary: Removes the pages you list.

options.name: pages
options.description: The pages to remove.

stages.summary: Inserts the pages of another uploaded PDF.

options.name: source
options.description: The uploaded PDF whose pages to insert.

options.name: at
options.description: Inserts after this page. `0` inserts before the first page.

options.name: sourcePages
options.description: The pages of `source` to insert.

stages.summary: Sets the rotation of pages. Viewers turn them clockwise.

options.name: angle
options.description: A multiple of 90, such as `90` or `-90`.

options.name: pages
options.description: The pages to rotate.

stages.summary: Draws a line of text over pages.

options.name: text
options.description: The text to draw.

options.name: pages
options.description: The pages to stamp.

options.name: x
options.description: The position, in points from the left edge.

options.name: y
options.description: The position, in points from the bottom edge.

options.name: fontSize
options.description: The size of the text, in points.

options.name: font
options.description: One of the 14 standard PDF fonts: `Helvetica`, `Times-Roman`, `Courier`, their `-Bold`, `-Oblique` or `-Italic` variants, `Symbol` or `ZapfDingbats`.

options.name: color
options.description: The color, as `#rrggbb`.

options.name: opacity
options.description: From 0 to 1. Unset, or `0`, draws the text opaque.

options.name: rotation
options.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise, around `x` and `y`.

stages.summary: Draws an uploaded PNG or JPEG image over pages.

options.name: image
options.description: The uploaded `.png`, `.jpg` or `.jpeg` image.

options.name: pages
options.description: The pages to stamp.

options.name: x
options.description: The left edge of the image, in points from the left of the page.

options.name: y
options.description: The bottom edge of the image, in points from the bottom of the page.

options.name: width
options.description: In points. Set `width` or `height` to keep the proportions; set neither to draw each pixel as a point.

options.name: height
options.description: In points.

options.name: opacity
options.description: From 0 to 1. Unset, or `0`, draws the image opaque.

options.name: rotation
options.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise, around `x` and `y`.

stages.summary: Draws a page of another uploaded PDF over pages: a letterhead, a seal.

options.name: source
options.description: The uploaded PDF to draw.

options.name: sourcePage
options.description: The page of `source` to draw.

options.name: pages
options.description: The pages to stamp.

options.name: x
options.description: The left edge, in points from the left of the page.

options.name: y
options.description: The bottom edge, in points from the bottom of the page.

options.name: scale
options.description: The scale factor.

options.name: opacity
options.description: From 0 to 1. Unset, or `0`, draws the page opaque.

options.name: rotation
options.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise, around `x` and `y`.

stages.summary: Writes the document information. A field you leave out keeps its value.

options.name: title
options.description: The title.

options.name: author
options.description: The author.

options.name: subject
options.description: The subject.

options.name: keywords
options.description: The keywords.

options.name: creator
options.description: The application that made the original document.

options.name: producer
options.description: The application that made the PDF.

options.name: creationDate
options.description: A PDF date, such as `D:20260101120000Z`.

options.name: modDate
options.description: A PDF date.

stages.summary: Replaces the bookmarks, the outline viewers show beside the pages.

options.name: bookmarks
options.description: Items with a `title`, a `pageNumber`, and optional `children` items.

stages.summary: Fills form fields.

options.name: fields
options.description: Values keyed by the fields' fully qualified names. `/forms/pdf/info` tells whether a PDF has a form.

stages.summary: Burns the form fields into the pages, which can then no longer be edited.
Replaces transparent content with opaque content, for printers and archival formats that don't support transparency.
Converts every color to one color space.

options.name: target
options.description: `cmyk`, `rgb`, `gray`, or `output-intent` for the document's own output intent.

stages.summary: Removes the content under each region from the file itself, not just from view. Nothing is drawn in its place.

options.name: regions
options.description: Rectangles with a `page`, and `x`, `y`, `width` and `height` in points from the bottom-left corner.

stages.summary: Infers a structure tree for an untagged PDF, so screen readers can follow it. PDF/UA requires one.
Embeds an uploaded file in the PDF.

options.name: file
options.description: The uploaded file to embed.

options.name: name
options.description: The name the PDF lists it under.

options.name: mimeType
options.description: The file's MIME type.

options.name: relationship
options.description: `Source`, `Data`, `Alternative`, `Supplement` or `Unspecified`. Makes the file a PDF/A-3 associated file.

stages.summary: Removes an embedded file.

options.name: name
options.description: The name the PDF lists the file under. `/forms/pdf/attachments` lists them; a name it doesn't list answers 400.

stages.summary: Rewrites the PDF to shrink it. Every option is on unless you turn it off. A signed PDF answers 400, and so does an encrypted one, unless the stages decrypt or encrypt it.

options.name: objectStreams
options.description: Packs objects into compressed object streams.

options.name: dedup
options.description: Stores identical streams once.

options.name: recompressImages
options.description: Recompresses images.

options.name: subsetFonts
options.description: Keeps only the glyphs the document shows.

stages.summary: Protects the PDF with passwords.

options.name: userPassword
options.description: The password to open the PDF. Set `userPassword`, `ownerPassword`, or both.

options.name: ownerPassword
options.description: The password to lift the permissions.

options.name: permissions
options.description: What a reader without the owner password may do: `print`, `printHighQuality`, `modifyContent`, `extractText`, `modifyAnnotations`, `fillForms`, `assemble`. Each is `true` unless you set it to `false`.

stages.summary: Opens encrypted PDFs and removes their encryption.

options.name: password
options.description: The password that opens the PDFs.

stages.summary: Repairs the PDF until it conforms to a profile. `Gotenberg-Remediation-Residual` counts the violations left: `0` means it conforms.

options.name: profile
options.description: `PDF/A-1a`, `PDF/A-1b`, `PDF/A-2a`, `PDF/A-2b`, `PDF/A-2u`, `PDF/A-3a`, `PDF/A-3b`, `PDF/A-3u`, `PDF/A-4`, `PDF/A-4e`, `PDF/A-4f`, `PDF/UA-1`, `PDF/UA-2` or `Factur-X`.

options.name: language
options.description: The document's language, as a BCP 47 tag such as `de-DE`.

options.name: aggressive
options.description: Allows fixes that may change how pages look, for better compliance.

options.name: figureAltText
options.description: The alternate text for figures that lack one.

options.name: xml
options.description: Factur-X only: the uploaded invoice XML to embed. Without it, Factur-X repairs the invoice the PDF already carries.

options.name: level
options.description: Factur-X with `xml`, required: `MINIMUM`, `BASIC WL`, `BASIC`, `EN 16931`, `EXTENDED` or `XRECHNUNG`.

options.name: documentType
options.description: Factur-X with `xml`: the document type written in the metadata.

example.response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/pdf
Gotenberg-Remediation-Residual: 0
Gotenberg-Remediation-Rolled-Back: 0

stages.summary: Signs the PDF with a certificate you upload.

options.name: certificate
options.description: An uploaded PKCS#12 file, or a PEM certificate with `key`.

options.name: key
options.description: The PEM private key that goes with a PEM `certificate`.

options.name: certificatePassword
options.description: The password that opens a PKCS#12 `certificate`.

options.name: reason
options.description: Why the PDF is signed.

options.name: location
options.description: Where it is signed.

options.name: contactInfo
options.description: How to reach the signer.

options.name: name
options.description: The signer's name.

options.name: pades
options.description: Makes a PAdES signature, the format eIDAS recognizes.

options.name: timestampUrl
options.description: An RFC 3161 timestamp authority to timestamp the signature with.

stages.summary: Adds a document timestamp from an RFC 3161 timestamp authority: proof the PDF existed, unchanged, at that time.

options.name: timestampUrl
options.description: The authority's `http://` or `https://` URL.

stages.summary: Draws pages as images, which come back in a ZIP next to the PDF: `report_1.png`. `/forms/pdf/render` returns the images alone.

options.name: pages
options.description: The pages to draw.

options.name: dpi
options.description: The resolution.

options.name: format
options.description: `png` or `jpeg`.

options.name: quality
options.description: `jpeg` only, from 1 to 100.
